extracted.name: Tofu Hiyayakko
extracted.description: Tofu hiyayakko is a genuine Japanese recipe of a few slices of soft tofu topped with fresh ginger and green onion and a wonderfully light dressing.
instruction_lines: Whisk soy sauce, sugar, dashi granules, and water together in small bowl until sugar dissolves.
Place tofu on a small plate; top with ginger, green onion, and bonito shavings. Drizzle soy sauce mixture on top; sprinkle with sesame seeds.
